purpose: Routing catalog for matching designed HTML to Campaign Cart starter template families and commerce-ready surfaces. Keep matching cheap and deterministic; ask the user when confidence is not high.

doNotInferFrom: one shared include such as payment-methods.html

copyReviewPolicy.purpose: Market-sensitive starter copy must be confirmed against the target campaign instead of blindly carried forward or automatically removed.
appliesWhen: builder records market mode as country-specific or multi-market
reviewSurfaces: visible carrier, warehouse, and manufacturing claims

warnOnlyPatterns.label: US shipping promise
examples: free shipping on all US orders

copyReviewPolicy.agentRule: When a warn-only pattern appears in a country-specific or multi-market campaign, treat it as replace-or-confirm campaign copy. Preserve it only when the CampaignSpec, source design, or operator explicitly confirms the claim. Do not remove it automatically.

packages.purpose: Named Campaigns App package ref_ids used by checkout selectors, bumps, and display bindings.
packages.agentRule: Replace starter refs from the target CampaignSpec/API. Remove optional bump surfaces when the referenced prepurchase package is absent.

shipping_methods.purpose: Named Campaigns App shipping method ref_ids used by checkout selector cards.
shipping_methods.agentRule: Use only on checkout/cart selector surfaces. Do not carry starter refs between campaigns; remove shipping_method rows when the target campaign has no matching method.

bundles.purpose: Checkout bundle-card rows for package quantity tiers.
sourceOfTruth: Campaigns API package and shipping refs
bundles.agentRule: Prefer package_id plus quantity. Use explicit items_json only for genuinely custom item sets.

variant_slots.purpose: MV/configurable bundle slots for selector rows and later variant choice stages.
sourceOfTruth: Campaigns API package refs and variant config
variant_slots.agentRule: Keep selector ids aligned with data-next-bundle-slots-for. Preserve configurable bundle item shape unless the API/spec says the package is non-configurable.

order_bump.agentRule: Enable only when the target campaign has the referenced package or offer. Do not leave warranty/insurance starter modules pointed at missing package refs. On Apollo and Apollo MV checkouts, `selector_order_bump_variant` controls the product-card bump immediately below the bundle/MV selector (`check03` or `none`); `order_bump_variant` controls only the later `.order-bumps` form-section slot — do not treat `order_bump_variant` as all bumps on the page.

sourceOfTruth: Campaigns API package refs and vouchers/offers
upsell_offer.agentRule: Post-purchase upsells do not use shipping_methods. Package refs and vouchers must come from the upsell page contract. `retail_shipping` and `offer_shipping` are display copy for the offer price block (the struck retail shipping line and the offer shipping line), not shipping method refs. The starter defaults claim `+$4.95 SHIPPING` and `+ FREE SHIPPING`; set both from the target campaign's real shipping figures whenever they differ.Upsell pricing_mode defaults to full_price (one visible price row) per template-brand-contract.shared-commerce.v0; set discounted / compare_at explicitly when an offer or voucher governs the price. Copy keys (pretitle, title, rating_text, cta_note, …) are display strings — HTML allowed, data-next-display spans allowed — never package refs.

sourceOfTruth: Campaigns API package refs and vouchers/offers
upsell_bundle_tiers.agentRule: Keep display tier and in-offer selector ids paired. Do not attach checkout shipping refs to upsell cards.

upsell_mv_tiers.purpose: Tiered post-purchase MV/configurable bundle upsell rows.
sourceOfTruth: Campaigns API configurable package refs and vouchers/offers
upsell_mv_tiers.agentRule: Pair with upsell_offer.package_id. Keep quantity tier ids aligned with upsells-mv.js and the hidden bundle selector; do not attach checkout shipping refs to MV upsells.

receipt_summary.purpose: Receipt order-item template ids and summary copy.
receipt_summary.agentRule: Preserve data-next-order-items templates and ids; change copy only through frontmatter when the family exposes it.

payment_flags.purpose: Visible payment method rows and express wallet flags.
payment_flags.agentRule: Payment config, CampaignSpec/API support, and visible rows must agree. On upsell and checkout pages the logo row resolves itself from next.getCampaignData() (available_payment_methods + available_express_payment_methods, platform payment-source codes); payment_flags.show_<code> is only a per-method override. Card brands: the platform exposes cards as the single code bankcard and the merchant's gateway accepted_card_types list (visa, mastercard, american_express, discover, diners_club, jcb, maestro, dankort; empty = all) is NOT in the campaign payload, so bankcard shows the four common tiles by default; the other four are opt-in (show_jcb: true) and any brand can be forced off (show_american_express: false). Use the platform codes, not abbreviations.

slot_personalization.purpose: MV slot-picker line-item personalization (SDK 0.4.27+). Adds a data-next-property input to each rendered bundle slot — on the checkout/select selector AND the post-purchase upsell offer — so units carry distinct text and become separate order lines. Same contract name across both surfaces.
sourceOfTruth: Template slot partials: mv-configurable-selector.html / mv-slot-stage.html (checkout/select) and upsell/offer-selector.html (MV upsell slot template)
slot_personalization.agentRule: MV/slot-rendering families only — per-line customization requires a slot picker (eng-confirmed); not available on tier-swap families. Same `slot_personalization` contract on MV checkout/select and MV upsell. Shipped enabled on `apollo-mv-single-step` and `olympus-mv-single-step` (checkout.html + upsell-mv.html), disabled on `olympus-mv-two-step` (one live reference each). To apply on any other MV page, set slot_personalization.enabled:true in that page's frontmatter — the shared partial renders the field from the same contract (no markup copy). property_key becomes the order line-item attribute name. Fill every slot explicitly; do not rely on an order-wide default to fill some slots and override others (same-package overrides drop). When paired with order_personalization, keep property_keys distinct (per-slot overrides the page default on a shared key).

order_personalization.purpose: All-lines line-item personalization default (SDK 0.4.27+) via data-next-default-property. One value is applied to every line the active bundle/cart write or upsell accept sends; on a single non-slot upsell this means the one accepted line gets the value.
sourceOfTruth: Campaign personalization requirement (one shared value across all units or one value on a single non-slot upsell)
Template partial: personalization-field.html; offer partials may render the same order_personalization contract with data-next-default-property
order_personalization.agentRule: Reliable for 'same value on every unit' and for single non-variant / non-slot upsells where the accepted set is one line. The generic partial ships in every family's _includes but is NOT wired into generic pages; opt in with a campaign_include or an offer partial that accepts order_personalization. For per-line distinct slot values use slot_personalization (MV checkout/select/upsell) instead. When paired with a per-slot field on the same surface, use a DISTINCT property_key: the merge is { ...default, ...slot } so a per-slot value overrides the default on a shared key (MV checkout uses custom_text vs slot number; MV upsell example uses gift_message vs slot upsell_message).

upsell_layout.purpose: Layout knobs for the composable upsell/offer.html shell.
sourceOfTruth: CampaignSpec upsell page copy / design spec
upsell_layout.agentRule: media: carousel|image|grid|video|none (the swiper area; video reads media_video, same contract as upsell_video — upsell_video itself is the content-column include under the heading); media_position: right (default, content left) | left; boxed false + upsell_hero.variant card is the long-form (VSL) look. Pure presentation — never derived from the API.

upsell_hero.purpose: Upsell title band (band) or band + overlapping offer card with countdown (card).
sourceOfTruth: CampaignSpec upsell page copy / design spec
upsell_hero.agentRule: HTML strings; quote SDK values with data-next-display spans (bundle.upsell-bundle-1x.* for the pinned 1× price on tier offers, bundle.<selector_id>.* on stepper/single-with-voucher, package.<id>.name everywhere).

upsell_video.purpose: VSL / product video rendered by upsell/video.html (native <video>).
sourceOfTruth: CampaignSpec upsell page copy / design spec
upsell_video.agentRule: src is a local asset path or an https URL — NEXT-hosted media MUST use cdn.cachebucket.com. autoplay defaults true and always pairs with muted (browser policy). Rendered under the offer heading whenever set; independent of upsell_layout.media. No player library. preload defaults metadata (autoplay) / none (autoplay: false). The <video> carries data-upsell-video (+ optional id) as the hook for a campaign-supplied player script; set controls: false when layering one on.

upsell_guarantees.purpose: Trust / guarantee cards under the accept button.
sourceOfTruth: CampaignSpec upsell page copy / design spec
upsell_guarantees.agentRule: variant stacked (centered icon + title + text) | row (badge left, "title text" right). Guarantee copy must match the store policy links in campaigns.json.

upsell_body.purpose: Ordered long-form sections between the offer and the closing CTA.
sourceOfTruth: CampaignSpec upsell page copy / design spec
upsell_body.agentRule: type reviews | features | comparison | steps. Section copy is design-owned; any price/percentage inside it is a data-next-display span, never a literal.

closing_cta.purpose: Closing CTA block after the body sections.
sourceOfTruth: CampaignSpec upsell page copy / design spec
closing_cta.agentRule: variant cta (centered button + note + decline) | card (boxed image + price rows + button + decline). Its accept/skip are data-upsell-proxy buttons forwarded to the single in-offer SDK action — never add a second data-next-upsell="offer" wrapper.

offer_bullets.purpose: Feature bullets in the upsell offer content column.
sourceOfTruth: CampaignSpec upsell page copy / design spec
offer_bullets.agentRule: Array of strings or { text }. Absent = demo bullets render; upsell_layout.show_bullets false removes the block.

ships_info.purpose: Shipping reassurance row under the upsell accept button.
ships_info.agentRule: text is HTML with a {flag} token for the inline flag image; the defaults claim USPS from the USA within 1 business day — replace with the merchant's real carrier and origin, or set upsell_layout.show_ships_info: false.

swiper_gallery.purpose: Carousel media for checkout and upsell pages (swiper-gallery.html).
swiper_gallery.agentRule: swiper_slides / swiper_thumbs are { src, alt } lists; aspect 16-9 | 3-2 | 4-3 (default square); fit contain | cover; swiper_thumbs_per_view default 6. Requires the Swiper CDN CSS + JS in the page styles: / scripts:.

media_images.agentRule: Four { src, alt } entries; used only when upsell_layout.media is grid.

media_video.purpose: Video in the upsell media column (upsell_layout.media: video).
media_video.agentRule: Same contract as upsell_video; independent of it so a page can carry a content-column VSL and a media-column video.

header_bar.agentRule: steps (logo + Checkout › Upgrades › Summary) | logo (centered logo only).

announcement.agentRule: announcement_variant primary (default) | danger | success | dark | light; absent or "" text renders nothing.

countdown_timer.purpose: Slim urgency bar + countdown (countdown-timer.html), used on checkout, upsells and inside the upsell hero card.
countdown_timer.agentRule: duration (seconds) renders the SDK data-next-timer persisted per persistence_id — give each offer its own id; start ("MM:SS") is the legacy checkout.js-driven mode. Absent = nothing renders.

surfaces.name: Apollo bundle upsell pages (composable upsell-offer shell)
surfaces.note: Every upsell page composes the same partial set: upsell-announcement → upsell-header-bar (steps|logo) → upsell-hero (band|card) → countdown-timer → upsell-offer (the shell; offer_type tier-cards|tier-pills|stepper|single|mv picks the ONLY piece that differs, upsell/offer-controls.html + upsell/offer-selector.html) → upsell-body (reviews|features|comparison|steps sections) → upsell-closing-cta (cta|card) → footer. upsell/offer.html owns the single [data-next-upsell="offer"] wrapper; the display-only 1x selector (tier-cards/tier-pills/mv) and the single-offer voucher selector sit outside it; the hidden state-machine selector is the first in-offer selector. upsell/offer-context.html resolves package_id / selector_id / price paths once (assign shares scope). upsell/closing-cta.html renders PROXY buttons (data-upsell-proxy=add|skip → initUpsellProxyActions() in upsells.js clicks the in-offer actions) so a page never has two SDK offer wrappers. pricing_mode (discounted|compare_at|full_price|unit_total|unit_only) lives in upsell/offer-prices.html; default full_price per the shared commerce contract, demo pages opt into discounted. upsell/video.html is a native <video> (autoplay+muted, controls) — no Plyr / custom controls; rendered under the heading whenever upsell_video is set (upsell_layout.media only picks the swiper-area content). Reference pages: upsell-bundle-stepper / -tier-pills / -tier-cards (classic band + boxed offer), upsell-single (offer + body sections + closing card), upsell-vsl (danger announcement bar, logo header, hero card + countdown, unboxed offer with video, guarantees, reviews, closing CTA). Identical set in all eight families, generated from _shared/upsell/ by sync-shared (lint:shared gate); MV families add upsell-mv.html with upsell_offer.type: mv. Switching upsell_offer.type alone renders a working selector: absent upsell_bundle_tiers / upsell_mv_tiers are generated from package_id (offer.tier_count, offer.vouchers_json) by upsell/offer-context.html + upsell/offer-tier.html; declare tiers only for distinct vouchers / labels.

surfaces.name: Apollo single-offer upsell page
surfaces.note: Single-package, fixed-price offer (accept or skip, no tiers) — now offer_type='single' on the shared upsell/offer.html shell; the long-form sections are upsell_body entries (features, comparison, steps) and the closing card is upsell/closing-cta.html variant=card whose accept/skip are proxies to the one SDK offer. Optional `voucher` renders a hidden linked bundle selector outside the offer (data-next-bundle-selector-id on the wrapper) and prices read bundle.<selector_id>.*; without a voucher they read package.* gated on package.hasRetailPrice / hasSavings (data-next-show and data-next-display on separate elements). pricing_mode full_price (default) | discounted | compare_at | unit_total | unit_only. Countdown uses the SDK data-next-timer.

agentNotes: Use Apollo when the design has the Apollo checkout shell (trust bar, product heading, promo banner/timer, as-seen-in, reviews slider, guarantee) plus tiered bundle cards — not a generic Olympus clone.

Do not add per-page checkout component CSS files; promoted styles live in canonical next-core.css synced across all eight families.
